alt_text: Stop overfitting your agent harness to benchmarks. The slide features a large 'RSI' graphic and the title text.
Agent Harness Evolution Problem: The architecture shows a fixed backbone policy optimized by harness components including prompts, control flow, tools, and memory.
The page discusses overfitting risks in iterative evolution. Figure 1 shows that evolution overfits on the test split, while RRSI generalizes improvements on the agentic workspace benchmark.
The RRSI regularization framework details the process: screening for leakage, evaluation with a noise-adjusted stability floor, and acceptance criteria.
Results show RRSI improves held-out splits by up to 4.7 points. The method gains 2.3 points on Harvey LAB and 1.8 points on SWE-bench Verified.
